editorial:
Imagine being so obsessed with a comedy act that you start seeing them everywhere you look. That is exactly what happens to Howard, a regular guy who is head-over-heels for his fiancée, Beverly. The problem is that Howard cannot stop thinking about The Three Stooges. He sees Moe, Larry, and Curly popping up in his daily life, and it starts to get out of hand. It feels like a wild ride through a man's breaking point, blending a sweet romance with some really goofy, over-the-top humor. You will find yourself rooting for Howard to get his head on straight before his big wedding day arrives.

The acting is fun and the pacing keeps things moving quickly, though some of the jokes might feel a bit dated since it came out in the eighties. The best part is seeing Howard lose it in the city streets with other fans. If you like weird, slapstick comedies, you should definitely give this a try. To get the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection so you can spot all the funny background details. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon with friends.
endingExplained: The story wraps up at the Stooge Hills sanitarium where Howard goes to get help. On graduation day, things go totally crazy when the patients decide they have had enough and take over the asylum. Instead of becoming a normal person, Howard fully embraces the chaos. He finds a sense of belonging with other people who love the Stooges just as much as he does, turning a mental breakdown into a big, funny party.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school comedy and weird characters
